title: All Quiet on the Western Front
author: Erich Maria Remarque
summary: Paul Bäumer joins up with his schoolmates in the First World War, fired by the speeches of their teacher. The trenches strip away every belief they had. A short, plain-spoken novel told from the German side.
readIf: you want an honest, unglamorous portrait of ordinary young soldiers and what the front does to them.
skipIf: you want hope or heroism, or find vivid battlefield injuries hard to read.

pairings.reason: Another anti-war classic, but told in a stranger, time-skipping and darkly comic way.
A science-fiction view of war's toll on soldiers who come home to a world that no longer fits.
A war novel from another conflict, with more romance and a lingering sense of fate.
